To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of biodiesel in gas turbine engines is feasible.
the transient response of the PT6 engine operating with blends of Jet A1 fuel and biodiesel has been studied.
a computer model has been developed and validated for predicting the performance of the PT6 engine when operating with different blends of Jet A1 biodiesel.
In summary, our research is concerned with

developing and validating a computer code to simulate the transient response of gas turbine engines operating under off design conditions, with the objective of predicting the best biodiesel blends to be used in real engines.
the development of a computer model that can be used to predict the transient behaviour of a PT6 gas turbine engine operating with different fuel blends.
the development and validation of a mathematical model to predict the performance of gas turbine engines, operating with different fuels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present model has been able to predict the behavior of the PT6 engine with different fuel blends and has also been capable to predict the behavior with the real Jet A1 fuel.

the computer code developed is a valuable tool to predict the engine's response under off design conditions and it is an important step towards the design of a new gas turbine engine that can operate with different fuels. (C) 2015 Elsevier Ltd. All

the present work has been able to provide the first step to the development of a reliable and robust simulation code that can be used to predict the transient response of the PT6 gas turbine engine, operating with different fuels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we can simulate the complete transient response of a real gas turbine engine, using a mathematical model and a numerical procedure, and we have shown that we can avoid the risk of engine damage when using biodiesel blends as fuel.
the proposed mathematical model and numerical code are capable to predict the transient response of the PT6 turbine engine operating with different blends of biodiesel.

we have developed a computer simulation model for the complete PT6A gas engine, and we have shown that it is a useful tool to analyze the transient engine behavior, and to find acceptable fuel blends to operate with biodiesel.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed model can be used as an effective tool to evaluate the performance of a gas turbine engine operating with different fuel blends, and it is also a good alternative to the GasTurb(r), since it is more accurate and cheaper than the latter.
, with a good computer model and a proper numerical procedure, one can simulate the transient response of an engine and, therefore, avoid the risk of damage to the real engine.
